landing.title: Your family, organized
landing.description: A private platform for community leaders and families to manage records, coordinate events, and stay connected across generations.
landing.featuresDescription: Everything you need to manage families, events, and records in one place
landing.feature1Desc: Visualize your family across generations with interactive tree views
landing.feature2Desc: Community heads, gotra heads, and family members each get the right permissions
landing.feature3Desc: Blood groups, allergies, and emergency contacts accessible when it matters
landing.feature4Desc: Organize gatherings with built-in approval workflows and RSVPs
landing.feature5Desc: Get notified about events, approvals, and announcements that matter to you
landing.feature6Desc: Maintain accurate family records without spreadsheets or confusion
landing.ctaDescription: Join hundreds of families already managing their heritage with our platform
